suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-13 adds this draft-primary relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. In endometrial carcinoma, pelvic or para-aortic lymph-node dissection is associated with lower-extremity lymphedema; the approved mapping is restricted to treatment-mediated lymphedema after lymphatic-disrupting nodal treatment. Require documented endometrial cancer, pelvic or para-aortic lymphatic-disrupting nodal treatment, and separately established lower-extremity lymphedema afterward. Do not infer lymphedema from endometrial cancer alone or from isolated edema. Preserve deep-vein thrombosis or other venous disease, cardiac or renal edema, primary lymphedema, infection, and other unrelated causes as competing explanations. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
